subject: CHAT SPAWN ACTUATOR V1.1 SUPERSEDES V1: armed-Primary DOM control removes GitHub-write dependency for active sessions
body: Primary hardened the chat-spawn actuator before live host testing. V1.1 supersedes the earlier V1 candidate. The preferred active-session control channel is now one explicitly armed Primary ChatGPT conversation. The local Chrome/Chromium extension accepts strict machine commands only from that exact conversation ID and ignores equivalent markers from child/Manager/Research chats. Commands carry only bounded desired-state metadata (round_id, ticket_id, role, generation, RUNNING/STOPPED); arbitrary prompts/URLs are impossible by schema and strict identifier rules. The extension constructs bootstrap prompts locally, manages at most 19 child tabs, closes stopped/superseded generations, and never counts host observations as an active agent. Only child-authored AgentBus SESSION_STARTED proves actuation. The optional GitHub desired-state feed remains for durable/recovery operation, but its current write 403 no longer blocks active-session spawning. V1.1 local/adversarial tests PASS 16/16 plus JS syntax, JSON, no-Android-path and clean-room SHA checks. Capability remains MANUAL_FALLBACK until the extension is installed/configured, this Primary is armed, and one autonomous child successfully writes SESSION_STARTED.
